properties.name: A claim that the design holds nothing about something says where it was checked
properties.statement:
When an agent tells a person that a design, or a family of designs, does not hold something (no requirement says X, it was never discussed, nothing records Y), the claim shall name where it was checked: which designs, which kinds of record, and how (the searches run, the records opened). "No flo2 requirement says a hub can sit inside a hub" is a claim; "that wasn't stated anywhere" is not, unless everywhere was searched. Served to every project as a standing rule in the instructions reflow2 serves, and in the hub skill.

Anthony, 2026-09-28, choosing "Search at the hub" (dec:until-designs-share-a-server-the-cross-design-check-runs-at-the-hub), which carried this rule. The measured failure: fact:root-cause-a-sibling-designs-precedent-was-surfaced-three-times-and-never-read-2026-09-28, where "wasn't stated anywhere" was a check of one design's requirements; the same class as fact:three-searches-that-did-not-happen-and-what-each-one-cost (2026-08-17).
